newsitem.title: UK: Sims revives retail division sale plan.
newsitem.headline: Sims revives retail division sale plan.

text.p: British food producer Sims Food Group Plc said a plan for a management buy-out of its retail division has been revived after it was suspended last year because of the "mad cow" disease crisis.
But as much of the dust has settled, managers Richard Canvin and David Gunner are working on the plan again, Sims said.
Canvin will resign as joint managing director of the retail division from April 30, while Gunner assumes responsibility of the whole division.
The retail division, which accounted for about three quarters of Sims Foods 160 million stg sales in 1996/97, is mainly involved in the slaughtering, butchering and packaging of beef.

Finance director Tony Cearns said it may take several months before a buy-out could be concluded. Sims wants to step out of the retail business because it wants to focus on its higher margin, non-commodity operations.
